title: Hidden Inside the Long Text
statement:
A word `s` and a text `t` are given. The word is hidden inside the text if you can delete some letters of `t` (possibly none) and be left with exactly `s`, keeping the order of the remaining letters.

## Input
The first line contains `s`. The second line contains `t`.

## Output
Print `YES` if `s` is hidden inside `t`, otherwise print `NO`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s|, |t| <= 90000`
- Both strings contain only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
